program:
if licenseName = "EMPLANT_VIEW" 
	-- The example models can not be managed with the Viewer License!
	-- The model will be closed.
	messagebox(to_str(Localization.getText(34),strChr(10),strChr(13),Localization.getText(35)), 1,13)
	closeModel -- return
else
	var s1:string := modelFile
	var Folder4Objects:string := strCopy(s1,1,StrRpos("\\",s1))
	Admin.Folder4Objects  := Folder4Objects
	var column4sort:integer 
	switch userInterfaceLanguage
	case 0
		Admin.DropDownList.Value := 2
		column4sort := 3 -- German
	else
		Admin.DropDownList.Value := 1
		column4sort := 4 -- English
	end
	
	SelDlg.label := Localization.getText(21) -- Beispielmodellsammlung, Examples Collection
	animation(true)
	comment.saveAsRichedit := true
	
	Admin.searchStr := ""
	SelDlg.setCaption("SearchString_inp","")
	
	var GenTable:table := SelDlg.GeneralTable
	var numObjects,numExamples:integer
	for var cat := 1 to GenTable.ydim
		var modTable:table := GenTable[1,cat]
		modTable.sort(column4sort,"up")
		for var TopicNo := 1 to modTable.Ydim
			numObjects += 1
			var FrameTab:table := modTable[1,TopicNo]
			FrameTab.sort(column4sort,"up")
			numExamples += FrameTab.Ydim
		next
	next
	
	SelDlg.open -- Eventcontroller.exampleStoppingTime > 0 =>> Eventcontroller.end := exampleStoppingTime
	clearConsole
	
	return -- comment out this return statement to test the consistency and completeness of the collection
	
	print "Number objects: ",numObjects
	print "Number frames: ",numExamples	
	
	var ObjFiles:list := getFilesOfFolder(to_str(Folder4Objects,"*.obj"))	
	
	
	var gTab:table := SelDlg.GeneralTable
	var fileName, FolderName:string
	var n:integer
	for var j := 1 to gTab.yDim 
		var t:table := gTab[1,j]
		for var k := 1 to t.yDim 
			FolderName := to_str(".Models.",t[2,k],".")
			fileName := to_str(t[2,k],".obj")
			if existsFile(to_str(Folder4Objects,fileName)) 
				.loadObjectAs(fileName ,"",true,false);
			else
				messageBox(to_str("The file ",fileName," is not in your installation."),1,1)
			end

			ObjFiles.cursor := 1
			if ObjFiles.find({1}..{*},fileName) 
				ObjFiles.cutRow(ObjFiles.cursor)									
				n := n + 1
			end

			var ObjTab:table := t[1,k]
			for var FrameNo := 1 to ObjTab.yDim
				if NOT existsObject(to_str(FolderName,ObjTab[2,FrameNo]))
					messageBox(to_str(fileName," does not in the frame ",ObjTab[2,FrameNo]),1,1)
				end
			next
		next -- k
	next -- j
	print n," objects are managed by the Example Collection."
		
	if ObjFiles.dim>0 
		s1 := ""
		for var j := 1 to ObjFiles.dim 
			if strLen(s1) > 2
				s1 := to_str(s1,", ",ObjFiles[j])	
			else
				s1 := ObjFiles[j]
			end
		next
		if strLpos(",", s1) > 0
			messageBox(to_str(s1," are not managed by the Example Collection."),1,1)
		else
			messageBox(to_str(s1," is not managed by the Example Collection."),1,1)
		end
	end

end -- else licenseName = "EMPLANT_VIEW"
